metaTitle: Custom Koi Sweaters & Cardigans | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Koi sweaters and cardigans in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for corporate gifts and team uniforms.
introHtml: Koi sweaters and cardigans combine classic knit style with durable construction, making them a standout choice for corporate apparel and team uniforms. The brand’s reputation for softness and consistent sizing means your logo or embroidery looks sharp order after order. Whether you’re outfitting a sales team for a winter promotion or creating holiday gifts for employees, Koi’s midweight fabrics keep wearers comfortable without adding bulk. Choose from crewnecks, V-necks, and button-front cardigans in versatile colors that work for any workplace dress code.
heroAltText: Custom Koi sweaters and cardigans with embroidered logo on front, available in bulk for corporate orders.
